newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Fazio says currency can resist pressure.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Fazio says currency can resist pressure.

text.p: The governor of the Bank of Italy, Antonio Fazio, was reported on Wednesday as saying that market forces and speculation could cause strong fluctuations in exchange rates but could not cause a currency crisis.
Fazio, asked about speculation on the lira, made the remark to parliament's Antimafia commission on Tuesday but a transcript was only made available on Wednesday.

"With the globalisation of the markets, speculative manoeuvres can today change prices by as much as 20 percent, compared to five percent some years ago. But nobody alone today can cause a currency crisis," he said.
